cards.name: Throw from the Saddle
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it instead if it's a Mount. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.

cards.name: Squirrel Sanctuary
cards.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, you may pay {1}. If you do, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Meltstrider's Gear
cards.oracle_text:
When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control.
Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has reach.
Equip {5} ({5}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Generous Stray
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, draw a card.

cards.name: Druid Class
cards.oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.
{2}{G}: Level 2
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
{4}{G}: Level 3
When this Class becomes level 3, target land you control becomes a creature with haste and "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control." It's still a land.

cards.name: Pistus Strike
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature with flying. Its controller gets a poison counter.

cards.name: Break Down
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

cards.name: Surly Farrier
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Dredger's Insight
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more artifact and/or creature cards leave your graveyard, you gain 1 life.
When this enchantment enters, mill four cards. You may put an artifact, creature, or land card from among the milled cards into your hand. (To mill four cards, put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)
